nodes.summary: Every nondeterministic Büchi automaton accepts the same language of infinite words as its presentation as a parity automaton (priority $2$ on accepting states, $1$ elsewhere).
nodes.title: Büchi-to-parity conversion preserves the language

nodes.summary: A nondeterministic parity automaton with states in $Q$ and symbols in $\Sigma$ is a nondeterministic automaton (a transition relation labelled by symbols on $Q$, together with a set of start states) with a priority $p(q) \in \mathbb{N}$ assigned to each state $q \in Q$.
nodes.title: Nondeterministic parity automaton

nodes.summary: Let $\mathcal{A}$ be a nondeterministic parity automaton with finitely many states and priority function $p$. For every infinite sequence of states $s_0, s_1, s_2, \dots$, the priority sequence $p(s_0), p(s_1), p(s_2), \dots$ satisfies the even or the odd max-parity condition: the largest priority occurring infinitely often exists and is even, or it exists and is odd.
nodes.title: Every state sequence of a finite parity automaton has a parity winner

nodes.summary: A nondeterministic Büchi automaton is turned into the nondeterministic parity automaton with the same states, transitions and start states, in which every accepting state has priority $2$ and every other state has priority $1$.
nodes.title: Büchi automata as parity automata

can_state.label: ready to state

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
